name: 01-unauthorized-request-redirects-to-salesforce
description: With no access token stored, sfdc:authorize redirects the browser (302) to the authorization URL with response_type=code, the Connected App's consumer key, the callback redirect_uri built from oauth-callback-config (http://localhost:8081/oauth2callback) display=page and a state value (Mule put its suspended event id there; the Spring module issues a single-use random value); nothing is sent to Salesforce's API. README step 2: 'You will redirected to Salesforce Login page'. The Location is matched by parameter because Mule's exact parameter order and state format are not documented.

source.reference: authenticating-salesforce-using-oauth2/src/main/app/salesforce-oauth.xml (sfdc:config-with-oauth consumerKey=${sfdc.key}, oauth-callback-config domain=localhost localPort=8081 path=oauth2callback; flow salesforce-oauthFlow1: sfdc:authorize authorizationUrl/accessTokenUrl display=PAGE, sfdc:query, foreach logger 'contact: #[payload]', set-payload 'Salesforce query returned #[payload.size()] contacts.')
